title: How AI can improve my game
author: Dolandev
selftext:
I am making a padel tennis mobile game in Unity using Claude Sonnet to code (i cannot code), chat GPT for discussing features and non AI assets like Synty for 3D models.

But the development is too slow. How can i use AI tools to improve my game?

comments.author: Dolandev
comments.body:
If anyone wants to try it, this is the link below.
Appreciate for the feedbacks.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dolangamestudio.padelcityplayground

comments.author: business_warrior
comments.body: To significantly improve your game you need real data to base your decisions on. Connect your game to firebase analytics or to GameAnalytics, run a google ads campaign on a small market with cheap CPC, and see the retention metrics and how many users return to your game. Once you get the data feed it to Claude to analyze and brainstorm options, then iterate.

replies.author: Dolandev
replies.body: Thank you. Will check it out.

replies.author: Critical_Hunter_6924
replies.body: Analytics can help you optimise a lot of things, but it won't tell you why your game is not fun.

replies.author: business_warrior
replies.body: It will, if people are coming back and spending lots of time in your game, good chances are it’s fun or they are masochists.

replies.author: Critical_Hunter_6924
replies.body: Sure, you can measure retention and duration, the analytics still won't make your game fun, that's up to you.
